description: This Java source file defines the REST API resource class for AdHoc queries in the Fineract platform. It provides endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and templating ad hoc SQL query data, utilizing JAX-RS annotations for RESTful web services. It manages interactions with services that handle ad hoc query data and enforces security via context authentication.

classes.name: AdHocApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing AdHoc query data, providing endpoints for various CRUD operations and templating.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch all AdHoc query data.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Provides a template of a new AdHocData object.

methods.name: createAdHocQuery
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new AdHoc query based on provided data.

methods.name: retrieveAdHocQuery
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a specific AdHoc query by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing AdHoc query by ID.

methods.name: deleteAdHocQuery
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an AdHoc query by ID.
